_comment: Project-level Claude Code settings — gộp 3 hook events: PreToolUse (Bash), PostToolUse (Write/Edit), SessionStart. Default stack: Python. Đổi sang bash/nodejs nếu cần.
_note_python: Dùng `python` (Windows ✓ / macOS python.org ✓ / Linux cần `python-is-python3` hoặc alias). Linux-only `python3` user đổi tay sang `python3` ở 4 dòng dưới.

PreToolUse._comment: Trước mỗi Bash command — validate commit + block dangerous
WISC Governance Gate (Tier 2) — chặn code change khi WISC gates status=required

PostToolUse._comment: Sau mỗi file write/edit — scan code quality + WISC auto-satisfy

hooks._comment: WISC Auto-Satisfy — detect spec.md / scout_report creation → flip gate satisfied (Tier 2)

SessionStart._comment: Inject reminder + drift check mỗi session để Claude nhớ pipeline + memory + cảnh báo nếu codebase đã drift khỏi baseline

hooks.command: echo 'Reminder: Tuân thủ pipeline trong CLAUDE.md (Phase 0→5). Phase 0 đọc project_state.yaml + schema_snapshot.yaml. Hard stops phải hỏi user. Rotate session ở 120k tokens.'

hooks._comment: Task tracker summary — show in_progress + ready tasks (fail-open)
Beads prime — load snapshot if Beads CLI installed (fail-open, F3.4 Anti-Amnesia)

Stop._comment: Cuối session — ghi event + beads sync (fail-open)

hooks._comment: Beads sync — persist state if Beads CLI installed (fail-open, F3.4 Anti-Amnesia)

statusLine._comment: Hiển thị Pattern + token count (vs 120k rotate threshold) + model + schema age + cwd. Refresh sau mỗi API response. Không có statusline thì comment block này ra.

_alternative_stacks._comment: Để dùng Bash hoặc Node, replace tất cả 'python .claude/hooks/python/X.py' bằng:
